skills.name: Dark Winds
skills.description: Allows you to use jump skills while using demon wings.\nGlide Command Lock: Right-click. Using the jump key in the middle of a jump during Glide Command Lock triggers a double jump.

skills.name: Curse of Fury
skills.description: When attacking, grants a chance to deal additional damage. Regenerates your HP while active. Also returns Fury when defeating enemies.

skills.name: Fury Unleashed
skills.description: When facing Bosses, unleash the full might of your Fury to do additional damage. When used in conjunction with Demon Lash, absorbs additional Fury.

skills.name: Exceed
skills.description: Exceed speeds up your attacks and makes you more powerful, but also strains your body and decreases the amount of HP you drain through Life Sap. When you reach the skill's final stage, the attacks will change. Your Overload increases if you use another Exceed skill.

skills.name: Wild Rage

skills.name: Blood Pact
skills.description: Activate a blood pact to convert your HP to Attack Power. This pact lets you ignore Warrior and Demon Avenger equipment stat requirements. Recovery skill efficiency increases do not affect HP recovery from the Demon Avenger's skills. In situations where HP cannot be recovered, HP consumed by the 1st through 4th tier job skills will be reduced.

skills.name: Exceed: Execution
skills.description: Uses the true powers of the Demon to deal a powerful slash, ignoring a portion of enemy defense.\r\nExceed: Attack speed gradually increases, along with HP cost. Attacks two more times at the final level.

skills.name: Nether Shield
skills.description: Enchant your shield with a tracking spirit, which hits an enemy and then bounces to the next target. If there are no other enemies nearby, the shield will attack the first enemy it hits. Targets the boss with the highest HP first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Nether Slice
skills.description: Attacks enemies and rips through armor. Any enemies hit will receive a debuff which temporarily reduces their defense rate.

skills.name: Blood Prison
skills.description: Imprisons enemies around you, stunning them for a short time.\nEnemies hit by this will resist stuns for 90 seconds and won't be stunned by other skills, like Blood Prison.

skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Not affected by Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Limits Surpassed
skills.description: Surpass your limits. Skills will not consume HP while this is active. Limits Surpassed is unaffected by the cooldown reset effect.

skills.name: Thousand Swords
skills.description: Summons a veil of darkness, then slashes through enemies at the speed of light. The speed stresses the body and increases Exceed Overload.

skills.name: Demonic Fortitude
skills.description: Calls upon demonic power to bolster your spirit.

skills.name: Forbidden Contract

skills.name: Demonic Frenzy
skills.description: Sacrifice your body to the flame to fuel your vengeance. The vengeance flows through your demonic blood, then emerges to attack the enemy. Your burning demonic blood is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

skills.name: Demonic Blast
skills.description: Sacrifice your own health to release an explosion of demonic energy. Can be used while other skills are active. If you defeat an enemy or strike a boss with this ability, you will recover HP, even under Demonic Frenzy's recovery reduction or certain other statuses that prevent you from recovering health (not including the ones in Ghost Park).

skills.name: Dimensional Sword
skills.description: Amplify the Desperado's power and call forth a brilliant, magical sword. When the sword spins, the attack deals damage to enemies even when they are under attack reflection. With Action Customization enabled, you can quickly spin the magical sword with just the skill key.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF

skills.name: Dimensional Sword
skills.description: Amplify the Desperado's power and call forth a brilliant, magical sword. When the sword spins, the attack deals damage to enemies even when they are under attack reflection.

skills.name: Revenant
skills.description: Your unceasing rage warps you into a specter, wavering between life and death.\nWhile active, HP cannot drop below 1 due to damage taken, you don't suffer debilitating status conditions, and the damage you take is saved as fury. Your fury then attacks the surrounding in the form of thorns, though it will also keep you in pain, even after the skill ends.\nUsing the skill again, while its effect is active, will cancel that effect. The thorns of fury deal damage to enemies with attack ignore and attack reflection. While Revenant is active, receiving continuous damage due to the fury effect will maintain your combat state.

skills.name: Revenant
skills.description: Draw on the power of rage, which damages you even as it strengthens you.

skills.name: HEXA Infernal Exceed

skills.name: Maximal Exceed
skills.description: Overflowing rage manifests as a Desperado.\nDesperado deals additional attacks on enemies when Exceed lands.\nAs rage grows deeper, power gets stronger and cooldown decreases periodically.

skills.name: HEXA Nether Shield
skills.description: Enchants your shield with a tracking spirit, which hits an enemy, then bounces to the next target. If there are no other enemies nearby, the shield will attack the first enemy it hit again. If each shield attacks a single boss monster repeatedly, reduced Final Damage will apply. When HEXA Nether Shield hits, only 2/3 of the HP restored from Life Sap and Advanced Life Sap apply. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Exceed: Execution

skills.name: HEXA Thousand Swords
skills.description: Summons a veil of darkness, then slashes through enemies at the speed of light. The speed stresses the body and increases Exceed Overload. Additionally, permanently increases HEXA Exceed: Execution damage.

skills.name: Requiem
skills.description:
Summon the Requiem Demon Sword to fulfill your thirst for vengeance. Using the skill again makes the demonic sword roar and perform a powerful attack. Demon Sword Roar can be used during Demon Avenger's attack skills, including Nether Shield. When casting Requiem and Demon Sword Roar while Demonic Frenzy is active, the HP recovery from Life Sap and Advanced Life Sap while invincible does not apply.
Requiem isn't an Exceed skill but still activates Infernal Exceed, Revenant's Thorn of Fury, and Maximal Exceed on certain attacks.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%
